name: Snowflake Document Agent
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /home/vscode/.snowflake && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.snowflake && sudo find /home/vscode/.snowflake -type d -exec chmod 0700 {} \; && sudo find /home/vscode/.snowflake -type f -exec chmod 0600 {} \; && mkdir -p /home/vscode/.ssh && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.ssh && sudo find /home/vscode/.ssh -type d -exec chmod 0700 {} \; && sudo find /home/vscode/.ssh -type f -exec chmod 0600 {} \;
